segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: P199.58 billion is for OO1, or Organizational Outcome 1, under the capital outlay operation, covering the principal mandates of the Department of Public Works and Highways: construction and maintenance of national roads, bridges, and other related infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: P83.84 billion is for OO2, or Organizational Outcome 2, under capital outlay operation, covering flood control, seawalls, and other related infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: P117.74 billion is for Foreign Assisted Projects, covering national roads, bridges, flood mitigation, and national building program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.

segments.text: In short, the Department of Public Works budget is not to build more, but to build better.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: Build accountable and build resilient budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.
segments.text: And on this account, I request the support of this honorable House of the People.
